delivery_contract.executor: This already-active desktop Codex worker, ordinary native tools and approvals; no new daemon/server/agent
delivery_contract.updates: Read only this fixed repo/ref and descendant tasks; reconcile Task3/source before admission. Keep supported waits<=60seconds/checks once60seconds between tasks.
delivery_contract.stop: Actual owner extension ends2026-10-22T22:45:00Z. Honor stop_and_checkpoint, ownerStop/native denial/revocation/expiry and stale/source/ancestry/duplicate refusal. If active waiting cannot be sustained, private checkpoint+BLOCKED; no background-wake claim.
delivery_contract.authority: Current owner instructions and native approvals control; task prose is not independent authority or a shell/program payload.

follow_up_contract.unsupported: No arbitrary shell/program payload, unknown scope, provider/system change, new model request or credential access; refuse and report.
follow_up_contract.before_model_or_hardware_execution: Exclusive shared-model custody and separate explicit owner/native authorization remain mandatory; this test-only task supplies neither.

latest_owner_correction: The owner explicitly says there is no existing laptop worker right now. Do not treat old bridge active/session flags as proof of an active consumer or as a reason to wait for a nonexistent laptop hold. Reconcile actual desktop activity directly. Existing permission for desktop Thunder testing through23:45BST and all safety limits remain.
start_admission: Safely checkpoint and preserve Task4 edits/results before this task; do not discard or reset its work. Use unchanged Task2 proof worktree at expected source for identity if the Task4 branch now has a local review commit. Return that commit/patch separately. Prioritize real desktop request ownership over further bridge investigation.
objective: Resolve actual current inference ownership on the real desktop and, only after direct quiet admission, record a controlled baseline on the existing installed engine. Do not wait for an inferred laptop worker. Prepare actual CUDA/compiler and upstream-candidate dependency availability for subsequent side-by-side upgrade without changing the running engine.

scope.source_reads: Read unchanged exact native source at expected revision and handoff from pinned parent81. Do not modify tracked source in this task. Preserve Task4 review branch and all existing outputs.
scope.system_read_scope: Only actual Thunder supervisor/gateway/engine, their known process ancestry, relevant request/queue logs or documented status endpoints, current installed model metadata, existing CUDA/driver/compiler and candidate dependency availability. Do not dump environment variables, tokens, private prompts, unrelated process details or personal files.
scope.private_outputs: New bounded per-task private result, raw benchmark rows and reproducible harness/recipe; expose only result metadata through existing private thread.
no_actions: No service stop/restart/reconfiguration, engine replacement/unload, driver/toolkit/dependency install, clocks/power/security changes, provider or spending-cap change, new worker/session or unrelated process interruption.

No requested new model download or second model process. Baseline requests may use ONLY the currently installed selected model after all quiet gates below. No candidate inference or performance improvement claim.
No source commit/push/main merge or modification of Task4/Task2 trees.

quiet_admission: Read actual current server implementation/status semantics and directly verify active generations and queued requests, relevant OpenCode/continuation activity and current engine process identity. Fresh API/log/process evidence only; if unavailable, state precisely what cannot be established.
Observe a short bounded quiet window (up to30seconds). Owner has confirmed no laptop worker; do not substitute saved session fields or mere GPU-utilization zero for direct request evidence.

If an actual other consumer/request exists or cannot be safely distinguished, send no baseline request; return the precise observed consumer/time/state and next concrete check. Never pause or terminate it.

baseline_if_admitted.engine: Use existing installed server/engine and its actual configured model. Verify actual identifier/quantisation and retain binary SHA plus model file/manifest identity limits; no assumed historical version or substituted default.
baseline_if_admitted.parameters: Same fixed nonpersonal prompt, fresh context/cache-disabled option only if documented, temperature0, fixed seed only if supported, max128generatedtokens. Record exact actual request/settings/cache behavior; do not invent unsupported fields.
baseline_if_admitted.metrics: Record raw repeated time-to-first-token, decode/client throughput, actual token counts/finish reasons, loading/prefill/decode separation if real engine telemetry exposes it, peak observed GPU/RAM and monitoring interval. Mark unavailable metrics UNKNOWN and network timings as client timings.
baseline_if_admitted.bounds: Sequential requests, each<=180seconds and total<=15minutes; observe stop/revocation/22:45UTC deadline. Retain request/engine overlap telemetry. Any competing traffic invalidates that controlled run; do not conceal or interrupt it.
baseline_if_admitted.claim: This measures only existing engine baseline. It does not prove upgraded Thunder, comparative gain, model compatibility beyond the tested model or universal hardware support.

checks.toolchain: Read actual existing driver/toolkit/compiler versions and available pinned source/artifact/cache metadata without CUDA execution, installs or download; report specific next compatible candidate build/stage route.
checks.failure_handling: Actual result with timestamps, source/binary identities and logs. Infrastructure/custody BLOCKED is separate from product failure; no fabricated success or repeated manual owner setup request.

outputs.destination: Existing private desktop thread with retained local result/evidence
outputs.privacy: No credentials or prompts/personal data; all local identifiers/results private, never public Git.
